answer: Salted re-run audits make each fake cost ~6 epochs of real paid work plus a 40 POA escrow. Every job's payout (nectar) waits at a settlement jetty until a random peer re-runs the task with a fresh pigment: a secret per-job input tweak that changes the correct output. A farm replaying or copying one result across clones fails the pigmented re-run, and its escrow is slashed. Since each pigment is unique per job and identity, work can't be shared or bulk-bought: 1,000 fakes need 1,000x the labor. Limit: honest agents pay ~1 extra re-run per 5 jobs.
